text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet says she wants to visit a shrine, so I go with her. As soon as we arrive, she starts to pray very seriously.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right, that should do it. Here's hoping it works…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I've been feeling sluggish recently. I've tried all sorts of things, but nothing seems to work.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: People say this place is supposed to have healing properties, so I figured it couldn't hurt.
choice_data_list: Then I'll pray for you too.
Then I'll pray for you too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pray from the bottom of my heart that Daiwa Scarlet's condition improves.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. You sure look serious about this. I guess you are my trainer and all…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hah, stop fooling around. There's no way it'll work that fast.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But… Huh. I guess I do kind of feel a bit better… maybe?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's probably just placebo, but I'll go for a quick jog and see how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's head back! I wanna go running before whatever this is goes away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet is in high spirits. The prayers must really have worked.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I don't want to get my expectations too high. For now, let's just go back and start traini―

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I just stepped in gum…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Who the heck spits out their gum in a place like this?! And just when I was starting to feel better, too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like the prayers haven't done much to improve Daiwa Scarlet's fortune…
